submission.justification: S3 has the highest raw significance (4.18 at 57%), but its data/MC disagreement is 35%, well above the 10% validation tolerance. Its background estimate is therefore not robust, so S3 is excluded. S1 (6% disagreement) and S2 (3%) both pass robustness. S1 peaks at 3.53 at 50% efficiency, which is higher than S2's best of 2.62 at 50%. The 50% working point is inside the 20-80% window. Caveat: the significances are stat-only and do not include systematics.
